items.note: Taxi PEK -> Sanlitun ~30-50 min. Leave bags at the bell desk.
Opens 9:00. Sources conflict on booking; one 2026 source says timed entry released 7 days ahead at midnight, so book to be safe.
Sanlitun Taikoo Li. Lunch from 11:00, queue numbers from ~10:30. Walk-in, long queues.

items.text:
16 MM Cafe
- Cafe ปลาคาร์ฟ
items.note: 57 Nanluoguxiang. 10:00-02:00. Goldfish under a glass floor.
Square needs a WeChat mini-program booking (1-7 days ahead), ID type Passport, bring originals. Forbidden City is closed Mondays, so it can't cover entry today.
At 16:30 take a remote queue number for Peking Chamber: WeChat mini-program 'Siji Minfu' → take a queue number (pai dui qu hao).
= Siji Minfu, Forbidden City branch, 11 Nanchizi St (Tiananmen East, L1). 10:30-21:30. Walk-in wait 1-3 hr, use the remote queue.
Passport = ticket. Weekday, low crowds. Check 8 Dec hours on universalbeijingresort.com (listed 10:00-20:00 Tue-Fri).
Jin Ding Xuan, Ditan branch, 77 Hepingli West St (Yonghegong, L2/L5). 24h. ~40 min taxi from Universal; resort shuttle stops 20:40.
07:30 check out, leave big luggage at hotel. Taxi to Qinghe ~45 min. Train ~1 hr. Book on 12306 / Trip.com.
Resort shuttle from the station. Check in, rental fitting.
Resort + hotel + her lesson not booked yet.
Book her Thai/English lesson through the resort.
Return gear and change by ~17:30.
Arrive Qinghe ~19:45. Taxi to Sanlitun hotel ~40 min, check back in.
Shuiguo Tangquan, Sihui (Sihui East, L1). 24h. ~20 min from Sanlitun. Ticket on Trip.com or at door. Bring passports. Bathing is nude, men and women separate.
~1.5 hr. Book a round-trip car; taxis refuse one-way from the Great Wall.
Tickets up to 15 days ahead, passport. Winter cable car/toboggan 8:30-16:30, can stop in bad weather.
Moved from Sunday. Friendship Store back courtyard, 17 Jianguomenwai (Yong'anli, L1). 11:00-22:00. On the way back to Wangfujing.
Henjiu Yiqian lamb skewers, 3.3 Mall 5F, Sanlitun. Opens 17:00. Remote queue on WeChat mini-program 'Henjiu Yiqian'.
Opens 08:30, last entry 15:30, closed Mondays. Tickets open Sun 6 Dec 20:00 Beijing = 19:00 Thai time; weekend sells out in minutes. Passport.

Her pick: Fangzhuanchang No. 69 zhajiang noodles (Michelin Bib, 10-15 min taxi, queue; this is the driver card) / Chengdu Zhujingban Sichuan (5-8 min walk from north gate) / Heyan Roubing Beijing meat pie (east gate).
Taxi ~50 min. Frozen Kunming Lake, stay to sunset ~16:50. Inner sites last entry 16:30.
Hu Teahouse Hotpot, Sanlitun SOHO Bldg 1, 3F. 24h, walk in. ~¥128/person. ~1 hr taxi from Summer Palace.
Leave bags at the bell desk.
Mondays: park open, halls closed (Hall of Prayer, Echo Wall, Circular Altar).
Sanlihe Park branch, 2 km from Temple of Heaven. Opens 10:00. No Sanlitun branch.
